name: zhihu/web/comment-v5
description: Get the comments on a Zhihu answer: comment text, author, time, like and reply counts, with sorting and pagination.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme:
# Zhihu Answer Comments API Returns the top-level comments on a Zhihu answer, each with its text, author, creation time, like and dislike counts, and a few preview replies. It needs an `answer_id`. Paging and sort order are optional. ## Use cases - Pull the most liked comments on an answer to see which views the readers agree with. - Track how the comment count on an answer changes by reading `counts.total_counts` over time. - Collect comment text with the author's city tag for a study of how opinions differ by region. - Find comments with many replies, then fetch their full reply threads. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/zhihu/web/comment-v5" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"answer_id": "2023560406912770519"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `answer_id` | string | Yes | Answer ID | | `limit` | string | No | Number of comments per page | | `offset` | string | No | Offset/Page Number | | `order_by` | string | No | Sort | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "ad_plugin_infos": [], "atmosphere_voting_config": { "daily_frequency": 1, "detail": [ { "emoji_level": "dissatisfied", "normal_icon": "https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-1d5d094f0cd71f7da08e7e54d037c0b5.png", "selected_icon": "https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-9af3c8aa46b63f2f840138b0ee6b0a99.png", "title": "不满" } ], "frequency_interval": 3, "location": 3, "min_num_of_root_comment": 10, "title": "你对该内容下的评论氛围是否满意？" }, "comment_status": { "induce_text": "", "text": "", "type": 0 }, "counts": { "collapsed_counts": 0, "reviewing_counts": 0, "segment_comment_counts": 0, "total_counts": 269 }, "data": [ { "_": null, "author": { "avatar_url": "https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-27bc715d780ecfc2402e01ada9c0e98f_l.jpg?source=06d4cd63", "avatar_url_template": "https://pic1.zhimg.com/v2-27bc715d780ecfc2402e01ada9c0e98f_l.jpg?source=06d4cd63", "badge_v2": { "detail_badges": null, "merged_badges": null, "title": "" }, "exposed_medal": { "avatar_url": "https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-0cbfd5688630e180e5732c71b9935608_r.jpg?source=06d4cd63", "can_click": true, "description": "赞同 30 次", "medal_avatar_frame": "", "medal_id": "972460827463282688", "medal_name": "表示赞同", "mini_avatar_url": "https://pica.zhimg.com/v2-0cbfd5688630e180e5732c71b9935608_r.jpg?source=06d4cd63" }, "gender": 1, "headline": "", "id": "318f3f9198703cf6aff20e05b75ca635", "is_advertiser": false }, "author_tag": [], "can_annotation": false, "can_author_top": false, "can_collapse": false, "can_delete": false, "can_dislike": true, "can_hot": false, "can_like": true, "can_more": true, "can_reply": true } ], "edit_status": { "can_reply": true, "toast": "彼此欣赏让讨论更加充实" }, "header": [], "is_content_author": false, "is_content_rewardable": true, "paging": { "is_end": false, "is_start": true, "next": "https://www.zhihu.com/api/v4/comment_v5/answers/2023560406912770519/root_comment…", "previous": "https://www.zhihu.com/api/v4/comment_v5/answers/2023560406912770519/root_comment…", "totals": 269 }, "sorter": [ { "text": "默认", "type": "score" } ] } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `counts.total_counts` | Total number of comments on the answer. | | `data[].id` | ID of the comment, as a string. | | `data[].content` | Comment text. Some comments contain HTML such as `

` and `` tags. | | `data[].created_time` | Time the comment was created, as a Unix timestamp in seconds. | | `data[].like_count / dislike_count` | Number of likes and dislikes on the comment. | | `data[].child_comment_count` | Number of replies under the comment. | | `data[].child_comments[]` | A short preview of replies to the comment. Each item has the same shape as a top-level comment. | | `data[].child_comment_next_offset` | Cursor value for the next page of replies to this comment. | | `data[].author.id / author.headline` | ID and profile headline of the comment author. | | `data[].comment_tag[].text` | Tag shown on the comment. Tags with `type` set to `ip_info` hold a place name such as `上海`. | | `paging.is_end` | `false` when more pages of comments are available. | ## Notes - Get the `answer_id` from a Zhihu answer URL, or from [Zhihu Question Answers](/apis/zhihu/web/question-answers). - Use `limit` and `offset` to page through comments. `paging.is_end` shows whether you have reached the last page. - To read all replies under one comment, call [Zhihu Sub Comments](/apis/zhihu/web/sub-comment-v5). ## Pricing $0.001 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization. ## Related APIs - [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3): Search Zhihu articles and answers by keyword and get titles, excerpts, authors, vote and comment counts, with sorting, content type and time filters plus offse… - [Zhihu Hot List](/apis/zhihu/web/hot-list): Get the Zhihu hot list: trending questions with title, excerpt, heat, answer and follower counts, and links. - [Get Zhihu AI Search (v2)](/apis/zhihu/web/ai-search-stream): Get Zhihu AI Search results (new endpoint).
